body:
Source: owner decision 2026-09-20 to repeal the core freeze (no GitHub issue; related open issues #139, #937, #731). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea: CONVENTIONS.md:35-37 hard rule 2 reads "**Core is frozen to ADDITIONS.** Never *add* to `packages/core/`. If core lacks something, implement locally in your `lib/` and note the gap in your README under "Core gaps"." Following it produced hand-synced copies: `packages/{coldstart,merge-forecast,model-router}/lib/active-tickets.mjs` are byte-identical (26 lines each, one sha256), `canonicalJson` is re-implemented in `packages/backlog-groom/lib/ledger-sig.mjs:36` and `packages/lesson-foundry/lib/route.mjs:52` although core exports one at `packages/core/lib/ledger.mjs:255`, and `tokenizeCommand` exists twice (`packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs:15`, `packages/review-calibration/lib/runner.mjs:17`). The rule is also stated inconsistently: CONVENTIONS.md says never ADD, while CONTRIBUTING.md:69, apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx:33, packages/core/README.md:1-6 and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:28 say never EDIT, which contradicts CONVENTIONS.md's own paragraph that a defect in core is fixed in core. Core was never frozen in practice: nine modules were added under packages/core/lib after the initial contract commit fc911937 (revision, risk-tier, scaffold-hygiene, prosecutor, shell, markdown, railpath, text, glob).

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Documentation/policy lane: nine prose files change and one test file is added. No `.mjs` under packages/, plugins/ or scripts/ changes except the new test. CONVENTIONS.md is the canonical statement; the other eight files summarize it. `docs/tools/core.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx` are hand-maintained mirrors of `packages/core/README.md`: edit by hand, never regenerate (`scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs` must not be run). The new test lives in scripts/test/ and is picked up automatically by the `scripts` segment glob in scripts/run-tests.mjs (`node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs`); no registry edit is needed. Run one file with `node --test scripts/test/core-shared-helpers-docs.test.mjs` from the worktree root. The test file name deliberately avoids the words policy, guard and validator: `packages/core/lib/risk-tier.mjs` classifies any path matching `**/*policy*`, `**/*guard*` or `**/*validator*` as a security-control path. Line numbers below are for main @ b2b5c6ea; if another change has reworded rule 2 of CONTRIBUTING.md or conventions.mdx in the meantime, replace the whole of rule 2 (from the line starting `2. ` to the line before `3. `) whatever its wording. `.md`/`.mdx` lines and the comments of the new test are scanned by scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs, one blank-line-separated paragraph at a time; use the replacement text below as written. In `.mdx` keep `<name>` inside backticks.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. CONVENTIONS.md: replace hard rule 2 (lines 35-46) and hard rule 3 (lines 47-48) with exactly:

2. **Shared helpers live in core.** When a second package needs a helper,
   promote it into `packages/core/` and import it from there: never keep a
   copy, and never re-implement something core already exports. An addition
   to core ships with a test in `packages/core/test/` and a declaration in
   `packages/core/index.d.ts`, and adds no runtime dependency to core.
   Dependencies point one way: core imports only `@adlc/tickets`, and
   `@adlc/gate-manifest` imports core. A helper that needs a package which
   imports core is promoted into that package instead, on the same terms.

   **A defect in a core primitive is fixed in core**, not worked around
   locally: a local patch leaves every other caller broken. Worked example —
   #1005: `fence()`'s delimiter was forgeable by the content it fenced. It
   was patched locally in `@adlc/autopilot`, and seventeen other call sites
   kept the defect until it was fixed in core. A core defect fix ships a
   regression test in `packages/core/test/` and names the issue it closes.
3. **Scope discipline.** Write ONLY inside your own `packages/<name>/`.
   Never touch other packages, ADLC.md, root files, or `.adlc/`. The one
   exception is a helper promotion under rule 2, made as its own change,
   which touches core and the packages that drop their copy.

Leave hard rule 1 (lines 33-34) untouched.
2. CONTRIBUTING.md:69-70: replace rule 2 with exactly:

2. **Shared helpers live in `@adlc/core`.** When a second package needs a helper, promote
   it into `packages/core/` (test in `packages/core/test/`, no new runtime dependency)
   instead of copying it, and never re-implement something core exports. A defect in a
   core primitive is fixed in core.

Leave CONTRIBUTING.md rule 3 and line 47 (`npm run preflight`, pinned by scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs) untouched.
3. apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx:33-37: replace rules 2 and 3 with exactly:

2. **Shared helpers live in core.** When a second package needs a helper, promote it into
   `packages/core/` (test in `packages/core/test/`, no new runtime dependency) instead of
   keeping a copy, and never re-implement something core exports. A defect in a core
   primitive is fixed in core, not worked around locally.
3. **Scope discipline.** Write ONLY inside your own `packages/<name>/`. Never touch other
   packages, `ADLC.md`, root files, or `.adlc/`. The one exception is a helper promotion
   under rule 2, made as its own change, which touches core and the packages that drop
   their copy.

4. .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:28: replace the checkbox with exactly: "- [ ] No helper is copied from `@adlc/core` or another package; anything added to `packages/core/` has a test in `packages/core/test/`."
5. packages/core/README.md: change the H1 (line 1) to `# @adlc/core` and replace the first paragraph (lines 3-6) with exactly:

Shared library for all ADLC tools. Tools import from it and never keep a
private copy of what it exports. When a second package needs a helper, promote
it here: add a test in `packages/core/test/`, a declaration in `index.d.ts`,
and no new runtime dependency. A defect in a core primitive is fixed here, with
a regression test. The full rule is CONVENTIONS.md hard rule 2.

Make the SAME two edits by hand in docs/tools/core.md (H1 at line 6, paragraph at lines 26-29); the paragraph must be byte-identical to the README's. Leave the "Import surface" block of both files untouched.
6. apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx: line 3 description starts "The shared foundation every ADLC tool imports:" (drop "frozen"); line 8 ends at "the shared library every gate imports." (drop the Status clause); replace the paragraph at lines 12-17 with exactly:

`@adlc/core` is the foundation the whole toolkit stands on: every gate imports
from it, and none keeps a private copy of what it exports. When a second tool
needs a helper, the helper is promoted into core, with a test and no new
runtime dependency, rather than copied; a defect in a core primitive is fixed
in core so every caller gets the fix. That discipline is what keeps
twenty-plus independently published tools behaving identically at their
boundaries.

and line 88 becomes "The full import surface:".
7. apps/docs/content/docs/reference/index.mdx:13: "frozen core" becomes "shared helpers in core". apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/index.mdx:82: "Frozen shared library:" becomes "Shared library:". Line 42 of that file ("Enforce frozen rails") and CONTRIBUTING.md:130 ("no frozen rail edited") describe rails, a different and live concept, and stay.
8. New test scripts/test/core-shared-helpers-docs.test.mjs (node:test, no fixtures, no temp dirs, no child processes, ROOT = two directories above the test file). POLICY_DOCS is the closed list of the nine files above. The old rule is matched by patterns scoped to core, so that rail wording ("frozen rails", "a path frozen on the base branch") stays legal in these documents: REPEALED = [/\bcore\b[^.\n]{0,40}\bfrozen\b/i, /\bfrozen[ -](core|contract|shared)\b/i, /package is frozen/i, /core gaps/i, /do not edit core/i]. Tests, 13 in total: (a) one table test for the patterns themselves - each OLD line below is matched by at least one pattern and each LIVE line by none (one sample per line, verbatim after the marker):
OLD> 2. **Core is frozen to ADDITIONS.** Never *add* to `packages/core/`. If core
OLD> 2. **`@adlc/core` is frozen.** Never edit `packages/core/`. If core lacks something,
OLD> - [ ] `packages/core/` is unchanged (it is frozen).
OLD> # @adlc/core — FROZEN CONTRACT
OLD> Shared library for all ADLC tools. **This package is frozen during tool
OLD> the gap in your README — do not edit core.
OLD> your README under "Core gaps".
OLD> layout, zero dependencies, frozen core, `--json`/`--prompt-only`
OLD> | [core](/docs/toolkit/core) | Frozen shared library: exit-code helpers |
OLD> The full import surface and frozen-contract notes:
LIVE> | rail-freeze | no frozen rail edited, and no *existing* ticket changed |
LIVE> | [rails-guard](/docs/toolkit/rails-guard) | Enforce frozen rails, declared suppressions, and manifest recording. |
LIVE> rejects any PR that edits a path frozen on the base branch.
The remaining tests: (b) one test per policy doc asserting no line matches any REPEALED pattern, reporting `file:line: text` for each hit; (c) CONVENTIONS.md matches /^2\. \*\*Shared helpers live in core\.\*\*/m, /\*\*A defect in a core primitive is fixed in core\*\*/, /#1005/, /packages\/core\/test\//, /no runtime dependency/; (d) CONTRIBUTING.md matches /^2\. \*\*Shared helpers live in `@adlc\/core`\.\*\*/m and conventions.mdx matches /^2\. \*\*Shared helpers live in core\.\*\*/m; (e) docs/tools/core.md includes verbatim the README's first paragraph (`readme.split('\n\n')[1]`, asserted longer than 80 characters). Headings and negatives only: do not pin the full prose of any rule. Write the test first and see it fail before editing any doc.
9. Regression guard: README.md, AGENTS.md, ADLC.md, CHANGELOG.md and every package README other than core's stay byte-identical.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The new test is red before the doc edits and green after. verify: `node --test scripts/test/core-shared-helpers-docs.test.mjs` (before the doc edits: 11 fail, 2 pass - the pattern table test and the mirror test pass; after: 13 pass, 0 fail)
- AC2 CONVENTIONS.md carries the new rule 2, keeps the fix-in-core paragraph with the #1005 example, and rule 3 names the promotion exception. verify: `grep -c "Shared helpers live in core" CONVENTIONS.md` prints 1; `grep -c "frozen to ADDITIONS" CONVENTIONS.md` prints 0; `grep -c "#1005" CONVENTIONS.md` prints 1; `grep -c "helper promotion under rule 2" CONVENTIONS.md` prints 1
- AC3 No policy doc restates the freeze. verify: `grep -n -i -E "frozen|core gaps|do not edit core" CONVENTIONS.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md packages/core/README.md docs/tools/core.md apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/reference/index.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/index.mdx apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx | grep -v -i -E "frozen[ -]rails?" | wc -l` prints 0 (it prints 19 on main @ b2b5c6ea)
- AC4 The core README and its docs/tools mirror carry the same new introduction. verify: `grep -c "The full rule is CONVENTIONS.md hard rule 2" packages/core/README.md docs/tools/core.md` prints 1 for each file (0 on main), and `node --test scripts/test/core-shared-helpers-docs.test.mjs` passes the test "docs/tools/core.md mirrors the core README introduction verbatim"
- AC5 Existing pins stay green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/preflight.test.mjs`; `npm test -w packages/core`; `node --test apps/docs/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 The change set is exactly the ten scoped paths. verify: `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | grep -v '^\.adlc/' | sort` prints exactly: .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CONVENTIONS.md, apps/docs/content/docs/reference/conventions.mdx, apps/docs/content/docs/reference/index.mdx, apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/core.mdx, apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/index.mdx, docs/tools/core.md, packages/core/README.md, scripts/test/core-shared-helpers-docs.test.mjs
- AC7 The prose guard accepts every touched paragraph. verify: `node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs origin/main` exits 0
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 and prints "mutation-gate: no source files changed — nothing to mutate." (it lists the ten paths as not a mutable source type; that is expected for a prose-and-test change)
- AC9 Full preflight green. verify: `npm run preflight`

OUT OF SCOPE: promoting any helper into core or deleting any local copy (active-tickets, canonicalJson, tokenizeCommand, isPlainObject, gh wrappers, locks, verdict.mjs); the "Core gaps" sections of the 22 other package READMEs and their 19 docs/tools mirrors; the source comments that cite the old rule in packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs:8, packages/gate-manifest/lib/forest.mjs:4, packages/ticket-prune/lib/store.mjs:2-6, packages/ticket-sync/lib/store.mjs:4, packages/ticket-sync/lib/validate.mjs:5, packages/coldstart/lib/verdict.mjs:12-13 and the three active-tickets.mjs files (several sit in trust-root-tier packages; editing one changes this lane's tier and requires a key-holder attestation); the autopilot worker denylist entry for `packages/core/**` (packages/autopilot/lib/denylist.mjs:26, lib/shaping-prompt.mjs:39, pinned by packages/autopilot/test/denylist.test.mjs) and docs/specs/issue-autopilot-local.md:582; CONVENTIONS.md hard rule 1 and the "Import surface" blocks that still show the relative import path; README.md, AGENTS.md, ADLC.md, CHANGELOG.md; historical specs under docs/superpowers/ and docs/specs/; any new ADR; `packages/core/lib/shell.mjs` (frozen by another open ticket).
title: conventions: repeal the core freeze - shared helpers are promoted into @adlc/core, never copied
